en.s: The murder of Eric V of Denmark in Finderup in 1286, had political consequences for the Danish nobles who had been in opposition. Several had powerful enemies, and wished to use the opportunity to punish them. As a result, they fled to Norway where the king ensured their protection. At the same time a costly arbitration was concluded between the Norwegian National Board and German merchants.

zh.s: 丹麦国王埃里克五世于1286年在芬德鲁普遇刺，给反对王室的丹麦贵族带来政治后果。其中一些贵族树敌众多，想借此机会报复，于是逃往挪威，国王在那里为他们提供庇护。与此同时，挪威国家议会与德国商人之间一项代价高昂的仲裁也告结束。

en.s: The Battle of Peritheorion on 7 July 1345 between the forces of Momchil, the quasi-independent ruler of Rhodope, and an allied Byzantine-Turkish force headed by John VI Kantakouzenos and Umur Bey of Aydin. The two armies met in front of the walls of the city of Peritheorion (near Xanthi, now in ruins), and the battle resulted in a crushing victory for the allied army, with Momchil himself falling in the field.

zh.s: 1345年7月7日，罗多彼地区近乎独立的统治者莫姆奇尔率军与拜占庭—土耳其联军交战。联军由约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯和艾登侯国的乌穆尔贝伊率领。两军在佩里塞奥里翁城墙前交战，该城靠近如今已成废墟的克桑西。联军大获全胜，莫姆奇尔本人也阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Suzdal (Russian: Битва под Суздалем) or the Battle of the Kamenka River was fought on 7 July 1445, between Russians under Vasily II and Tatar troops of Oluğ Möxämmäd, who invaded the principality of Nizhny Novgorod. The Russians were defeated by troops of beg Mäxmüd, who became Mäxmüd of Kazan after the battle. Vasily was taken prisoner and was set free only after the enormous (200,000 roubles) ransom was paid.

zh.s: 苏兹达尔战役（俄语：Битва под Суздалем）又称卡缅卡河战役，于1445年7月7日爆发，交战双方是瓦西里二世率领的俄军和奥卢格·穆罕默德率领的鞑靼军。后者入侵了下诺夫哥罗德公国。俄军被贝格·马赫穆德率领的部队击败，贝格·马赫穆德在战后成为喀山的马赫穆德。瓦西里被俘，只有在支付了巨额赎金（20万卢布）后才获释。

en.t: Rehabilitation trial of Joan of Arc
en.s: The conviction of Joan of Arc in 1431 was posthumously investigated on appeal in the 1450s by Inquisitor-General Jean Bréhal at the request of Joan's surviving family—her mother Isabelle Romée and two of her brothers, Jean and Pierre. The appeal was authorized by Pope Callixtus III. The purpose of the retrial was to investigate whether the trial of condemnation and its verdict had been handled justly and according to ecclesiastical law. Investigations started in 1452, and a formal appeal followed in November 1455. On 7 July 1456, the original trial was judged to be invalid due to improper procedures, deceit, and fraud, and the charges against Joan were nullified.

zh.s: 1450年代，宗教裁判总审判官让·布雷阿尔应圣女贞德在世家人——母亲伊莎贝尔·罗梅和两个兄弟让、皮埃尔——的请求，对她1431年的定罪判决启动上诉调查。教宗卡利克斯特三世批准了上诉。复审旨在调查原审的定罪程序及判决是否公正、是否符合教会法。调查于1452年开始，正式上诉于1455年11月提出。1456年7月7日，原审因程序不当、欺骗和舞弊被判无效，对贞德的指控也被撤销。

en.s: The Battle of the Sarno (7 July 1460), also known as the Battle of Nola, was a decisive defeat of the forces of Ferdinand, king of Naples, by his dissatisfied barons supporting the claim of John of Anjou, duke of Lorraine. It was fought in the plain at the mouth of the Sarno River in Campania, south of Mount Vesuvius.

zh.s: 萨尔诺战役发生于1460年7月7日，又称诺拉战役。洛林公爵安茹的约翰的拥护者——一批对那不勒斯国王费迪南多不满的男爵——使费迪南多的军队遭遇决定性败绩。战斗发生在坎帕尼亚维苏威火山以南、萨尔诺河入海口的平原上。

en.s: The Second Battle of Mokra (Albanian: Beteja e dytë e Mokrës) took place on 7 July 1462, just before Skanderbeg's Macedonian campaign. Sultan Mehmed II had emerged victorious from his recent campaigns, adding large tracts of land to his empire. He was confident enough to send a new force into Albania to weaken the Albanian forces. So he sent an army under Sinan bey to complete the task.

zh.s: 第二次莫克拉之战于1462年7月7日、斯坎德培发动马其顿战役前夕发生。苏丹穆罕默德二世近期连战获胜，占领了大片土地，于是派辛南贝伊率军进入阿尔巴尼亚，削弱当地军队。

en.s: The Battle of Otumba was a major battle fought on 7 July 1520 between the Aztec Empire and its allies led by the Cihuacoatl Matlatzincátzin, and Spanish conquistadors under Hernán Cortés, alongside support from the Confederacy of Tlaxcala. The battle was fought on the plain of Temalcatitlán, near modern-day Otumba during the conquest of the Aztec Empire by Spain. The result of the battle was a successful defense for the Spanish, which allowed Cortés to reorganize his army, having suffered heavy casualties a few days before during his army's retreat from the Aztec capital Tenochtitlan, now known as La Noche Triste.

zh.s: 奥通巴战役是1520年7月7日阿兹特克帝国及其盟军，与西班牙征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯及特拉斯卡拉联盟援军之间的一场重要战役。阿兹特克一方由奇瓦科阿特尔·马特拉钦卡特辛领导。战斗发生在特马尔卡蒂特兰平原，靠近今天的奥通巴，当时西班牙正征服阿兹特克帝国。西班牙军队成功防守，科尔特斯因此得以重整部队；此前几天，他的军队在撤离阿兹特克首都特诺奇蒂特兰时损失惨重，这次撤退如今称为“悲痛之夜”。

en.s: The siege of Šabac or Szabács occurred on 7 July in the year 1521 when the Ottoman Empire conquered the Šabac fortress. In 1520 Suleiman the Magnificent ascended to the throne. The Ottomans under the leadership of Ahmed Pasha conquered the fortress of Šabac on 7 July in 1521. All of its defenders were killed.

zh.s: 沙巴茨围城战又称萨巴奇围城战，奥斯曼帝国于1521年7月7日攻占沙巴茨要塞。1520年，苏莱曼大帝登基。1521年7月7日，艾哈迈德帕夏率领奥斯曼军队攻下沙巴茨要塞，守军全部被杀。

en.s: This battle in the Northern Seven Years' War took place on 7 July 1565 and was a decisive victory for a Swedish fleet of 49 ships, under Klas Horn, over a combined Danish and Lübecker fleet of 36 ships, under Otte Rud.

zh.s: 这场北方七年战争中的海战于1565年7月7日发生。克拉斯·霍恩率领的瑞典舰队有49艘船，决定性地击败了奥特·鲁德率领的丹麦与吕贝克联合舰队（36艘船）。

en.s: The Raid of the Redeswire, also known as the Redeswire Fray, was a border skirmish between England and Scotland on 7 July 1575 which took place at Carter Bar, the Cheviot pass which enters Redesdale. The skirmish was between the English Warden of the Middle Marches, Sir John Forster, with George Heron, Keeper of Redesdale, Keeper of Liddesdale and Scottish Warden and Sir John Carmichael, the Lord Warden of the Marches, with George Douglas of Bonjedworth.

zh.s: 雷德斯怀尔边境冲突也称雷德斯怀尔战斗，于1575年7月7日在英格兰与苏格兰边境的卡特巴尔发生，地点是通往雷德斯代尔的切维厄特山口。英方由中边区典狱长约翰·福斯特爵士和乔治·赫伦等人率领；苏方由边区长官约翰·卡迈克尔爵士和邦杰沃思的乔治·道格拉斯率领。

en.s: Articles of the Treaty of Nemours (or Treaty of Saint-Maur) were agreed upon in writing and signed in Nemours on 7 July 1585 between the Queen Mother, Catherine de' Medici, acting for the King, and representatives of the House of Guise, including the Duke of Lorraine. Catherine hastened to Saint-Maur-des-Fossés, where on 13 July the treaty was signed between King Henry III of France and the leaders of the Catholic League, including Henri, duc de Guise. The king was pressured by members of the Catholic League to sign the accord which was recognized by contemporaries as a renewal of the old French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 1585年7月7日，凯瑟琳·德·美第奇以王太后身份代表国王，与吉斯家族代表（包括洛林公爵）在内穆尔书面商定并签署了内穆尔条约（又称圣莫尔条约）的条款。凯瑟琳随后赶往圣莫尔德福塞，7月13日，法国国王亨利三世与天主教联盟领袖（包括吉斯公爵亨利）在那里签署条约。国王是在天主教联盟成员施压下签署协议的。当时人们认为，这项协议使法国宗教战争再度延续。

en.s: The Raid on Żejtun, also known as The Last Attack (Maltese: L-aħħar ħbit), was the last major attack made by the Ottoman Empire against Hospitaller-ruled Malta. The attack took place in July 1614, when raiders pillaged the town of Żejtun and the surrounding area before being beaten back to their ships by the Order's cavalry and by the inhabitants of the south-eastern towns and villages.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 泽伊通突袭又称“最后一次进攻”（马耳他语：L-aħħar ħbit），是奥斯曼帝国对医院骑士团统治下的马耳他发动的最后一次重大袭击。袭击发生于1614年7月，袭击者洗劫了泽伊通镇及周边地区，随后被骑士团骑兵以及东南部城镇和村庄的居民击退至船上。

en.s: The Battle of the Gianh River was a naval clash between the Dutch East India Company (VOC) navy and the Vietnamese Nguyen navy that took place off the coast of Gulf of Tonkin, at the mouth of the Gianh River. The Dutch fleet was in coordination with the northern lord Trịnh Tráng to assault the Nguyens in the south, but a Nguyen fleet commanded by prince Nguyễn Phúc Tần pursued the Dutch fleet and engaged them on the Gianh River, resulting in a Nguyen victory.

zh.s: Gianh河战役是荷兰东印度公司海军与越南阮氏海军之间的一场海战，发生在北部湾沿岸、Gianh河入海口附近。荷兰舰队与北方主政者郑梉协同，计划进攻南方的阮氏政权；但由阮福瀕王子率领的阮氏舰队追击荷兰舰队，并在Gianh河与其交战，最终阮军获胜。

en.s: The Neapolitan Revolt of 1647 was a popular revolt by the people of Naples led by Tommaso Aniello (known as Masaniello). Throughout the Thirty Years' War, rage and discontent arose among the Neapolitan residents against the ruling Spanish Duke of Arcos Rodrigo Ponce. The rebellion was a success and the most famous event was the Fire of Piazza Mercato.

zh.s: 1647年那不勒斯起义是由托马索·阿涅洛（人称马萨涅洛）领导的那不勒斯民众起义。三十年战争期间，那不勒斯居民对统治者、西班牙阿尔科斯公爵罗德里戈·庞塞日益愤怒和不满。起义最终成功，其中最著名的事件是市场广场大火。

en.s: The Battle of Castelo Rodrigo, also known as the Battle of Salgadela, was fought on 7 July 1664, near Figueira de Castelo Rodrigo, between Spanish and Portuguese as part of the Portuguese Restoration War. After a number of skirmishes, the Duke of Osuna attacked the castle of Castelo Rodrigo with 7,000 men and 9 pieces of artillery. The castle was only defended by 150 Portuguese.

zh.t: 卡斯特洛罗德里戈战役
zh.s: 卡斯特洛罗德里戈战役又称萨尔加德拉战役，是葡萄牙复国战争的一部分，于1664年7月7日在菲盖拉-德卡斯特洛罗德里戈附近爆发，交战双方为西班牙和葡萄牙。几次小规模交战后，奥苏纳公爵率领7,000人和9门火炮进攻卡斯特洛罗德里戈城堡。守堡的葡萄牙人只有150人。

en.s: The siege of Novi Zrin (New Zrin Castle); Croatian: Utvrda Novi Zrin; Hungarian: Új-Zrínyivár; Turkish: Zerinvar) in June/July 1664 was last of the military conflicts between the Croatian forces (with allies) led by Nikola Zrinski, Ban (viceroy) of Croatia, and the Ottoman army commanded by Köprülü Fazıl Ahmed Pasha, Grand Vizier, dealing with possession of Novi Zrin Castle, defended by Croats, situated on the bank and marshy islands of Mura River, near the border line between northern Croatia and southwestern part of Hungary, at the time occupied by the Ottomans.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 新兹林堡（克罗地亚语：Utvrda Novi Zrin；匈牙利语：Új-Zrínyivár；土耳其语：Zerinvar）围城战发生于1664年6月至7月，是尼古拉·兹林斯基领导的克罗地亚军队及其盟友，与科普吕律·法泽勒·艾哈迈德帕夏大维齐尔率领的奥斯曼军队之间最后一场军事冲突。双方争夺由克罗地亚人守卫的新兹林堡。城堡坐落在穆拉河畔的沼泽岛屿上，靠近当时由奥斯曼帝国占领的匈牙利西南部与克罗地亚北部边界。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Martinique took place off the Caribbean island of Martinique from 30 June to 7 July 1667, towards the end of the Second Anglo-Dutch War. A French fleet commanded by de la Barre was virtually destroyed by a Royal Navy squadron under Sir John Harman. Victory meant the English restored their position in the region shortly before the Treaty of Breda ended the war on 31 July 1667.

zh.s: 马提尼克海战于1667年6月30日至7月7日在加勒比海的马提尼克岛附近发生，正值第二次英荷战争接近尾声。德·拉巴尔指挥的法国舰队几乎被约翰·哈曼爵士率领的英国皇家海军分舰队全歼。这场胜利使英国恢复了其在该地区的地位；随后战争于1667年7月31日以《布雷达条约》结束。

en.s: The siege of Ostend took place during the War of the Spanish Succession. In the wake of the Allied victory over the French at the Battle of Ramillies in May 1706, town and cities across the Spanish Netherlands rapidly surrendered to the Duke of Marlborough's victorious forces often without a fight. Ostend, a port on the North Sea coast, offered more resistance.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥斯坦德围城战发生于西班牙王位继承战争期间。1706年5月，盟军在拉米伊战役中击败法国后，西属尼德兰各城镇迅速向马尔伯勒公爵的胜利之师投降，往往不战而降。奥斯坦德是北海沿岸港口，抵抗得更为顽强。

en.s: The First Battle of Terrenate on July 7, 1776 was a military engagement during the Spanish period of Arizona. It was fought between Spanish soldiers and Apache warriors, near the Presidio Santa Cruz de Terrenate in the present day southern Arizona.

zh.s: 第一次特雷纳特战役于1776年7月7日发生，是西班牙统治时期亚利桑那的一场军事交战。战斗发生在当今亚利桑那州南部的圣克鲁斯·德·特雷纳特要塞附近，交战双方为西班牙士兵和阿帕奇战士。

en.s: The Battle of Hubbardton was an engagement in the Saratoga campaign of the American Revolutionary War fought in the village of Hubbardton, Vermont. Vermont was then a disputed territory sometimes called the New Hampshire Grants, claimed by New York, New Hampshire, and the newly organized and not yet recognized but de facto independent government of Vermont. On the morning of July 7, 1777, British forces, under General Simon Fraser, caught up with the American rear guard of the forces retreating after the withdrawal from Fort Ticonderoga. It was the only battle in Vermont during the revolution.

zh.s: 哈伯顿战役是美国独立战争萨拉托加战役的一场交战，发生在佛蒙特州哈伯顿村。当时佛蒙特仍是有争议的领土，有时被称为新罕布什尔拨地，纽约州、新罕布什尔州以及新近成立、尚未获承认但事实上独立的佛蒙特政府都声称拥有该地。1777年7月7日上午，西蒙·弗雷泽将军率领的英军追上了从提康德罗加堡撤退的美军后卫部队。这是独立战争期间佛蒙特境内唯一一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Monte Settepani (24 June–7 July 1795) saw the Coalition armies of Habsburg Austria led by Feldzeugmeister (FZM) Joseph Nikolaus de Vins and the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont led by Feldmarschall-Leutnant (FML) Michelangelo Alessandro Colli-Marchi attack the Republican French Army of Italy led by General of Division (GD) François Christophe de Kellermann during the War of the First Coalition.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙塞特佩塔尼山战役发生于1795年6月24日至7月7日。第一次反法同盟军中，哈布斯堡奥地利军由FZM约瑟夫·尼古拉斯·德·温斯指挥，撒丁—皮埃蒙特王国军由FML米开朗基罗·亚历山德罗·科利-马尔基指挥；两军进攻由师级将军弗朗索瓦·克里斯托夫·德·凯勒曼率领的法国共和军意大利方面军。

en.s: The Capture of La Croyable, or the Action of July 7, 1798, occurred when the French privateer schooner La Croyable was taken by the American sloop-of-war USS Delaware on 7 July 1798 during the Quasi-War. The engagement resulted in the first capture of any ship by the United States Navy, which had been formed just months before the action.

zh.s: 1798年7月7日，在准战争期间，法国私掠双桅纵帆船“可怖号”被美国战争单桅帆船“特拉华号”俘获，这次交战又称1798年7月7日海战。美国海军成立仅几个月，这是它首次俘获舰船。

en.s: The Quasi-War, 1798 to 1800, was an undeclared war between the United States and the French First Republic. It was fought almost entirely at sea, primarily in the Caribbean and off the East Coast of the United States, with minor actions in the Indian Ocean and Mediterranean Sea. In 1793, Congress suspended repayment of loans made by France during the American Revolutionary War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 准战争是美国与法兰西第一共和国之间一场未正式宣战的战争，持续时间为1798年至1800年。战斗几乎全部发生在海上，主要位于加勒比海和美国东海岸附近，印度洋和地中海也发生过少量交战。1793年，美国国会暂停偿还法国在美国独立战争期间提供的贷款。

en.s: The action of 7 July 1799 was a minor naval engagement of the Napoleonic Wars in which the Spanish 34-gun frigate Nuestra Señora del Carmén captured the Royal Navy's 18-gun hired armed cutter Penelope, which was under the command of Lieutenant Frederick Lewis Maitland.

zh.s: 1799年7月7日的海战是拿破仑战争期间的一场小规模海战。西班牙34炮护卫舰Nuestra Señora del Carmén俘获了英国皇家海军租用的18炮武装小型帆船Penelope；该艇由弗雷德里克·刘易斯·梅特兰中尉指挥。

en.s: The Raid on Dunkirk of 7 July 1800 was an attack by a British Royal Navy force on the well-defended French anchorage of Dunkirk in the English Channel during the French Revolutionary Wars. French naval forces had been blockaded in their harbours during the conflict, and often the only method of attacking them was through fireships or "cutting-out" expeditions, in which boats would carry boarding parties into the harbour at night, seize ships at anchor and bring them out. The attack on Dunkirk was a combination of both of these types of operation, aimed at a powerful French frigate squadron at anchor in Dunkirk harbour.

zh.s: 1800年7月7日，英国皇家海军部队袭击了英吉利海峡沿岸防御严密的法国敦刻尔克锚地，这是法国大革命战争期间的一次行动。战争期间，法国海军被封锁在港口，通常只能使用火船，或派船员夜间乘小艇进入港口、登上并夺取停泊船只再将其驶出的“夺船”行动来攻击。敦刻尔克袭击结合了这两种行动，目标是停泊在港内的一支强大的法国护卫舰分舰队。

en.s: The First Battle of the Isonzo was fought between the Armies of Italy and Austria-Hungary on the Italian Front in World War I, between 23 June and 7 July 1915. The aim of the Italian Army was to drive the Austrians away from its defensive positions along the Soča (Isonzo) and on the nearby mountains. Although the Italians enjoyed a 2:1 numeric superiority, their offensive failed because the Italian commander, Luigi Cadorna, employed frontal assaults after impressive (but short) artillery barrages. The Austrians had the advantage of fighting from uphill positions barricaded with barbed wire which were able to easily resist the Italian assault.

en.t: Colombo Town Guard officer Henry Pedris is executed in British Ceylon for allegedly inciting persecution of Muslims
en.s: Duenuge Edward Henry Pedris (Sinhala: හෙන්රි පේද්රිස්; 16 August 1888 – 7 July 1915) was a Ceylonese militia officer and a prominent socialite. en.s: The Safra massacre, or the Day of the Long Knives, occurred in the coastal town of Safra (north of Beirut) on 7 July 1980, during the Lebanese civil war, as part of Bashir Gemayel's effort to consolidate all the Christian fighters under his leadership in the Lebanese Forces. The Phalangist forces launched a surprise attack on the Tigers, a 500-man militia that was the armed force of the National Liberal Party of former Lebanese President Camille Chamoun. The attack was supposed to be conducted at around 4:00 a.m., but in order to spare the life of Camille's son and commander of the Tigers Dany Chamoun, the attack was postponed to 10:00 a.m. to make sure that Dany left for Fakra.

en.t: K-1 World MAX 2004 World Tournament final
en.s: K-1 World MAX 2004 World Tournament Final was a kickboxing and martial arts event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the third K-1 MAX final for middleweight kickboxers (70 kg/154 lb weight class) involving eight finalists and two reserve fighters, with all bouts fought under K-1 rules. Seven of the eight finalists had won elimination fights at the K-1 World MAX 2004 World Tournament Open, while the last finalist and both reserve fighters were invited despite suffering defeats. As well as tournament matches there was also an opening fight, fought under K-1 rules and a super fight fought under K-1 mixed rules (2 rounds of kickboxing, 2 rounds of MMA). In total there were fourteen fighters at the event, representing nine countries. The tournament winner was Buakaw Por. Pramuk who won the ten million yen first prize by defeating reigning K-1 MAX champion and pre-tournament favourite Masato in the final by unanimous decision after an extra extension round. It was an excellent victory for the relatively unknown Thai who would burst on to the global kickboxing scene and would go on to become a real force in the middleweight division. The other notable result saw popular local MMA fighter Norifumi "Kid" Yamamoto defeat kickboxer Yasuhiro Kazuya in their special MMA vs kickboxing match. The event was held in Tokyo at the Yoyogi National Gymnasium, on Wednesday, 7 July 2004 in front of 14,000 spectators.

zh.t: K-1 World MAX 2004世界锦标赛决赛
zh.s: K-1 World MAX 2004世界锦标赛决赛是由K-1组织主办的踢拳与格斗赛事，也是K-1 MAX中量级（70公斤／154磅级）第三场决赛，共有8名决赛选手和2名替补，所有比赛均按K-1规则进行。8名决赛选手中有7人通过K-1 World MAX 2004公开赛的淘汰赛晋级；最后一名决赛选手和两名替补虽在比赛中落败，仍获邀参赛。除锦标赛比赛外，赛事还安排了一场按K-1规则进行的开场赛，以及一场按K-1混合规则进行的特别赛（2回合踢拳、2回合综合格斗）。赛事共有来自9个国家的14名选手参加。锦标赛冠军是播求（Buakaw Por. Pramuk），他在加赛回合后以一致判定击败卫冕K-1 MAX冠军、赛前夺冠热门魔裟斗，赢得1000万日元的一等奖。这场胜利令这位当时名气不大的泰国选手走上国际踢拳舞台，此后成为中量级的一位重要选手。另一场引人注目的比赛中，当地颇受欢迎的综合格斗选手山本德郁（“Kid”山本）在特别的综合格斗对踢拳比赛中击败踢拳选手Yasuhiro Kazuya。赛事于2004年7月7日星期三在东京代代木第一体育馆举行，现场有14,000名观众。

en.s: On 7 July 2005, Islamist terrorists carried out four coordinated suicide bombings targeting commuters travelling on London's public transport during the morning rush hour. The attacks are sometimes known as the 7/7 bombings or simply 7/7. Three terrorists separately detonated three homemade bombs in quick succession aboard London Underground trains in Inner London. Later, a fourth terrorist detonated another bomb on a double-decker bus in Tavistock Square.

en.s: The Rafah terror attack, also called the "Battle of Al-Barth", was a terrorist attack conducted by the Islamic State – Sinai Province on an Egyptian Armed Forces checkpoint in Rafah in North Sinai on 7 July 2017 and resulted in the death and injury of 23 Egyptian soldiers, including the high-ranking El-Sa'ka officer, Col. Ahmed Mansi. 46 terrorists were killed and six cars of the militants were destroyed in the attack.

zh.s: 2017年7月7日，伊斯兰国西奈省分支对埃及北西奈省拉法的一处武装部队检查站发动恐怖袭击，又称“阿尔巴斯战役”。袭击造成23名埃及士兵死伤，其中包括埃尔萨卡部队高级军官艾哈迈德·曼西上校。袭击中有46名恐怖分子被打死，武装人员的6辆汽车被毁。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mongolia on 26 June 2017. Incumbent president Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj, first elected in 2009 and re-elected in 2013, was constitutionally barred from running for a third term. For the first time, no candidate received a majority vote in the first round, forcing a run-off between the Democratic Party (DP) candidate Khaltmaagiin Battulga and the Mongolian People's Party (MPP) candidate Miyeegombyn Enkhbold on 7 July, brought forward from 9 July.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙古于2017年6月26日举行总统选举。时任总统查希亚·额勒贝格道尔吉于2009年首次当选、2013年连任，依法不得竞选第三个任期。首次出现没有候选人在首轮投票中获得过半数选票的情况，因此举行第二轮投票，由民主党候选人哈勒特马·巴特图勒嘎对阵蒙古人民党候选人米耶贡布·恩赫包勒德。第二轮原定于7月9日，后提前至7月7日举行。

zh.s: 第53届卡罗维发利国际电影节于2018年6月29日至7月7日在捷克卡罗维发利举行。电影节共展映236部影片，其中35部为全球首映、8部为国际首映、7部为欧洲首映。

en.s: The 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup final was an association football match which determined the winner of the 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup. It was the eighth final of the FIFA Women's World Cup, a quadrennial tournament contested by the women's national teams of the member associations of FIFA. The match was played on 7 July 2019 at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais in Décines-Charpieu, a suburb of Lyon, France. The final was contested by the United States, the defending champion, and the Netherlands, in their first final.

zh.t: 2019年国际足联女足世界杯决赛
zh.s: 2019年国际足联女足世界杯决赛是一场决定该届赛事冠军归属的足球比赛，也是女足世界杯历史上的第八场决赛。这项赛事每四年举办一次，由国际足联成员协会的女子国家队参赛。决赛于2019年7月7日在法国里昂近郊代西讷-沙尔皮约的奥林匹克公园球场举行，由卫冕冠军美国队对阵首次闯入决赛的荷兰队。

en.s: Slammiversary XVII was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on July 7, 2019 at Gilley's Dallas in Dallas, Texas. It was the fifteenth event under the Slammiversary chronology. Eight matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Sami Callihan defeated Tessa Blanchard in an Intergender match.

zh.s: Slammiversary XVII是Impact Wrestling制作的一场职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2019年7月7日在得克萨斯州达拉斯的Gilley’s Dallas举行。这是Slammiversary系列第15场赛事，共进行了8场比赛。主赛中，萨米·卡利汉在一场男女对决中击败泰莎·布兰查德。

en.s: The 2019 Copa América final was a final match of the 46th edition of Copa América tournament that took place on 7 July 2019 at the Estádio do Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil to determine the winner of the 2019 Copa América. The match featured Brazil, the tournament hosts and Peru, in which Brazil won the match 3–1 to clinch their ninth Copa América title and their first since 2007.

zh.s: 2019年美洲杯决赛是第46届美洲杯的冠军决胜赛，于2019年7月7日在巴西里约热内卢的马拉卡纳体育场举行。东道主巴西队对阵秘鲁队，并以3比1获胜，夺得队史第九个美洲杯冠军；这是他们自2007年以来首次夺冠。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 7 July 2019. The elections were called by Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras on 26 May 2019 after the ruling Syriza party lost the European and local elections. They were the first national elections since the voting age was lowered to 17, and the number of parliamentary constituencies was increased from 56 to 59.

zh.s: 希腊于2019年7月7日举行议会选举。总理亚历克西斯·齐普拉斯在执政党激进左翼联盟于欧洲议会选举和地方选举中失利后，于5月26日宣布提前举行选举。这是投票年龄降至17岁后的首次全国选举，议会选区数量也从56个增加到59个。

en.s: The 2019 CONCACAF Gold Cup final was a soccer match which determined the winners of the 2019 CONCACAF Gold Cup. The match was held at Soldier Field in Chicago, Illinois, United States, on July 7, 2019, and was contested by Mexico and the United States. It was the sixth Gold Cup final to be contested by Mexico and the United States, and the first since 2011.

zh.t: 2019年中北美洲及加勒比海金杯赛决赛
zh.s: 2019年中北美洲及加勒比海金杯赛决赛是决定该届赛事冠军归属的一场足球比赛，于2019年7月7日在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥的士兵体育场举行，由墨西哥队对阵美国队。这是两队第六次在金杯赛决赛中交手，也是自2011年以来首次再次对决。

en.s: The 2020 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary took place on July 7, 2020, alongside the Delaware primary, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. It was originally planned for June 2 together with four other primaries, but was moved due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The New Jersey primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 146 delegates, of which 126 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2020年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年新泽西州民主党总统初选于2020年7月7日举行，与特拉华州初选同日进行，属于民主党总统候选人提名初选的一部分。初选原定于6月2日与另外四州的初选同时举行，后因新冠疫情而改期。新泽西州采用半封闭式初选，共分配146名代表，其中126名承诺代表按初选结果分配。

en.s: The 2020 Delaware Republican presidential primary took place on July 7, 2020, along with the New Jersey primary on the same day. Donald Trump won the primary by a wide margin. Rocky De La Fuente, the only candidate other than Trump on the ballot, won his highest share of the vote in this primary.

zh.t: 2020年特拉华州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年特拉华州共和党总统初选于2020年7月7日举行，与新泽西州初选同日进行。唐纳德·特朗普以较大优势赢得初选。除特朗普外，唯一列在选票上的候选人是洛基·德拉富恩特；他在这场初选中的得票率是自己参加过的初选中最高的。

zh.s: 2020年特拉华州民主党总统初选于2020年7月7日举行，与新泽西州初选同日进行，属于民主党总统候选人提名初选的一部分。初选原定于2020年4月28日举行，是东北部多个州“阿西拉初选”的一部分，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: Jovenel Moïse, the 48th president of Haiti, was assassinated on 7 July 2021 at 1:00 am EDT (UTC−04:00) at his residence in Port-au-Prince. A group of 28 foreign mercenaries, mostly from Colombia, are alleged to be responsible for the killing. First Lady Martine Moïse was also shot multiple times in the attack and was airlifted to the United States for emergency treatment.

zh.t: 若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺案
zh.s: 海地第48任总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹于2021年7月7日美国东部夏令时间凌晨1时（UTC−04:00）在太子港住所遇刺身亡。据称，28名外国雇佣兵参与了这起刺杀，多数来自哥伦比亚。第一夫人马蒂娜·莫伊兹在袭击中也身中数枪，随后被空运至美国接受紧急治疗。

en.s: The 26th Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival (Korean: 제26회 부천국제판타스틱영화제), an international film festival held in Bucheon, South Korea, began on 7 July 2022 with the slogan 'Stay Strange'. A non-competitive international film festival with a competitive section, opened with film Men by Alex Garland. This year the festival resumed its offline events after two years, which were curtailed due to COVID-19.

zh.t: 第26届富川国际奇幻电影节
zh.s: 第26届富川国际奇幻电影节（韩语：제26회 부천국제판타스틱영화제）是一场在韩国富川举行的国际电影节，于2022年7月7日开幕，主题口号为“保持奇异”。电影节设有竞赛单元，并以亚历克斯·加兰执导的电影《男人》开幕。受新冠疫情影响，电影节线下活动连续两年受限；本届恢复了线下活动。

en.t: Boris Johnson announces his resignation as leader of the Conservative Party following days of pressure from the Members of Parliament (MPs) during the July 2022 United Kingdom government crisis
en.s: Alexander Boris de Pfeffel Johnson (born 19 June 1964) is a British politician and writer who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Conservative Party from 2019 to 2022. He was previously Foreign Secretary from 2016 to 2018 and Mayor of London from 2008 to 2016. He was Member of Parliament (MP) for Henley from 2001 to 2008 and for Uxbridge and South Ruislip from 2015 to 2023.

zh.t: 英国政府危机期间，议员连续数日施压后，鲍里斯·约翰逊宣布辞去保守党领袖职务
zh.s: 亚历山大·鲍里斯·德·普费费尔·约翰逊（1964年6月19日出生）是英国政治人物和作家，2019年至2022年担任英国首相和保守党领袖。他此前于2016年至2018年担任外交大臣，2008年至2016年担任伦敦市长。2001年至2008年，他是亨利选区议员；2015年至2023年，他代表乌克斯桥和南赖斯利普选区。

The event took place on July 7, 2024, at the Scotiabank Arena in Toronto, Ontario, Canada as part of Money in the Bank weekend.

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 30 June and 7 July 2024 (and one day earlier for some voters outside of metropolitan France) to elect all 577 members of the 17th National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. The election followed the dissolution of the National Assembly by President Emmanuel Macron, triggering a snap election after the National Rally (RN) made substantial gains and Macron's Besoin d'Europe electoral list lost a significant number of seats in the 2024 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 法国于2024年6月30日和7月7日举行立法选举，部分法国本土以外地区的选民提前一天投票，选出法兰西第五共和国第17届国民议会的全部577名议员。此前，极右翼国民联盟在2024年欧洲议会选举中大幅增加席位，而马克龙的“需要欧洲”选举名单失去大量席位，随后总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙解散国民议会并提前举行选举。

en.s: The 2024 Tokyo gubernatorial election took place on 7 July 2024 to elect the Governor of Tokyo. Incumbent Yuriko Koike was re-elected for a third term, albeit at a reduced share of the votes compared to her 2016 election and 2020 re-election. Shinji Ishimaru, the former Mayor of Akitakata, exceeded expectations to place second behind Koike.

zh.s: 东京于2024年7月7日举行都知事选举。现任知事小池百合子再次当选，开启第三个任期，但得票率低于她在2016年和2020年选举中的表现。前安艺高田市市长石丸伸二的表现超出预期，排名第二，仅次于小池。
